name: wootty
description: WooTTY: modern web terminal with resilient PTY sessions

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web build && cd apps/server && go build ./...
scripts.ci: pnpm lint:ci && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.lint:go:ci: sh -c 'cd apps/server && go fix -diff ./... && out=$(gofmt -l .); if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$out"; exit 1; fi'
scripts.lint: biome check --write --assist-enabled=true . && pnpm lint:go && pnpm verify:docs-paths && pnpm verify:governance && pnpm verify:go-toolchain && pnpm typecheck
scripts.lint:ci: pnpm biome:ci && pnpm lint:go:ci && pnpm verify:docs-paths && pnpm verify:governance && pnpm verify:go-toolchain && pnpm typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @icoretech/wootty-web test && cd apps/server && go test ./...
